messages.subject: custom cell probabilities in bayesian time removal model
parts:
Hi,
The Kery and Royle applied modeling text shows how to construct custom cell probabilities for unequal time intervals in a removal model (page 348).  I need to use this approach in a Bayesian mixture model from section 7.6.3.  Below is my try at specifying those probabilities for a count consisting of a 3 min, 2 min, and then 5 min interval.  I left off the product with lambda for readability.  Is it correct?

My try
  pi[,1]<-1-(1-p[i])^3
  pi[,2]<-(1-p[i])^3 (1-(1-p[i])^2)
  pi[,3]<-(1-p[i])^5 (1-(1-p[i])^5)


Thanks,
Tom
